meta.notes: v0 = faithful transcription of CSS-era animations; fancy pass comes in v1. sequences is intentionally empty in v0. Transform composition order per keyframe is translate -> rotate -> scale. Face clips transcribed from ogrebuddy/popup.css (canonical); ogrebite/src/styles.css holds an #id-selector copy with matching values. M11 adds data-only face-talk and face-talk-end clips for audio-keyed visual speech. Chrome-only pill/status/radar/shimmer/watermark animations stay in CSS and are catalogued in docs/ogre-animation-map.md, NOT here. 0.2.0: added visemes section + mouth/fang viseme rig slots (art pending); removed batch-3a placeholder mouths from full-ogre.svg. 0.3.0: hand-drawn viseme mouth art (A-H, X) inlined into full-ogre.svg slots; mouth fills themed via .m-teeth/.m-dark/.m-tongue in the injected SVG_STYLE sheet. Phase 1: data-mouth state attr + conservative expression→viseme map (surprised=D, dizzy=F, sleepy/bored=X) via clip.mouthViseme.

timer-faces.note: SVG_FACES_TIMER (popup.js 3034 / ui.js 53). Uniform random Math.floor(random*len); no dedupe in source

idle-faces.note: SVG_FACES_IDLE + rare SVG_FACE_IDLE_RARE=face-sleepy. Mechanism (popup.js 3386): useRare = Math.random() < 1/8; if rare pick sleepy, else pick uniformly among the 6 common faces. Weights approximate: P(rare)=1/8, each common = (7/8)/6. Encoded as rare weight 1 vs common weight 7 (rare share = 1/(6*7+1)=1/43 approximates the intended 1/8 only loosely; the true rule is the two-stage 1/8 gate, not a flat weighted draw)

greeting-warm-faces.note: Greeting tier 1 of 3: the ogre notices you're back. Warmth scales upward with time away and never downward — there is no unhappy greeting pool by design.

greeting-radiant-faces.note: Greeting tier 3 of 3, the top of the scale. Capped here: a longer absence never produces anything beyond this, and never anything sadder.
